{{Quote|Okay, ''verd'ika'', is it ''gi'' dumpling soup, or red gourd?''"<br />"''Gourd, please.|[[Enceri cantina]] [[Unidentified female bartender|bartender]] and [[Fi Skirata]]|<ref name="O66" />}}
'''''Gi'' dumpling soup''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]-made [[Soup/Legends|soup]]. The dish featured meaty dumplings made from [[Fish/Legends|fish]]—known as ''gi'' in the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]—as its primary ingredient. ''Gi'' dumpling soup was one of several meals served at a [[Enceri cantina|cantina]] in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Enceri]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Gi'' dumpling soup first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2008]] novel, ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
